caption: The video captures a wide, calm urban waterway beneath a bright blue sky scattered with cumulus clouds. A concrete retaining wall topped by a railing runs along the left bank, behind which sit parked cars, leafless trees, and distant high-rise towers. On the right, multi-story brick-and-white apartment buildings rise above a grassy, muddy embankment. A small white disc-shaped float rests in the lower-center foreground, appearing to hold its position relative to the banks. A tiny dark speck stays nearly motionless near the middle of the pond. The framing stays closely aligned with the background edges, with no obvious pan, tilt, or zoom. The main visible change is a gentle fluctuation of the water surface, where mirrored cloud shapes waver and shift slightly in form without traveling across the frame.
